research_question: Can a 48 KiB query-only low-rank adapter, trained against the immutable 1M M32x8 IVF-PQ reconstruction with separate Top-10 protection and Top-100 promotion losses, recover end-to-end known-positive Recall@100 without damaging Recall@10 or same-route FP32 retrieval?
scope: single-seed, outcome-informed MS MARCO 1M development pilot; no document encoder training, document re-encoding, IVF/PQ mutation, RARS fitting, oracle_audit access, future-role access, external confirmation, deployment claim, novelty claim, or paper claim

positioning.primary_constraint: the deployed document index is byte-identical before and after training
positioning.passing_authorizes_only: a separately frozen development audit of the exact selected seed-42 checkpoint

precondition.v6_result_sha256_policy: bind at runtime to the hash registered by the verified durable complete record; telemetry makes the result JSON intentionally run-specific

data_policy.dataset: deterministic qrels-preserving 1M MS MARCO passage development corpus

split.method: label-blind SHA-256 ordering of string query IDs

forbidden_roles.oracle_audit: the exact pinned v3 parent builder may rematerialize its qrels-free candidate artifact as a lineage side effect, but the v7 trainer may not open it and no oracle_audit labels or metrics may be materialized, opened, or computed
forbidden_roles.future_method_holdout: must remain identity-only; no arrays, labels, candidates, or metrics may be opened or computed

judgment_semantics.challenger: candidate absent from positive qrels; unjudged, not explicit non-relevant

data_policy.parent_rematerialization_caveat: the pinned v3 builder deterministically writes qrels-free oracle_design and oracle_audit candidate artifacts together; only oracle_design identity/vectors are passed to v7, oracle_audit remains unlabeled and unopened by the v7 trainer, and future_method_holdout remains identity-only

frozen_index_contract.deployment_score: adapted query inner product with the fixed reconstructed residual-PQ document inside the original query's 16 probed lists

adapter.initialization: V normal std 0.02; U exactly zero; epoch zero is the identity baseline

pair_mining.candidate_union: frozen Base-PQ Top-200 union same-route FP32 Top-200 union routed positives

promotion_top_100.definition: explicit-positive versus unjudged boundary challenger with positive same-route FP32 margin and non-positive fixed-PQ margin

protection_top_10.definition: an explicit positive in Base-PQ Top-10 versus an unjudged Base-PQ rank 11-26 challenger when the same-route FP32 teacher margin is positive

pair_mining.penalty_interpretation: the pairwise objective lowers an unjudged challenger's score relative to an explicit positive; it is not an absolute non-relevance label
pair_mining.query_balancing: within each pair type, every represented query has equal total loss weight

objective.teacher: original query scored against FP32 documents inside the original IVF probes
objective.student: adapted query scored against immutable reconstructed-PQ documents inside the original IVF probes

eligible_if: hard-PQ Recall@10 is no more than 0.0025 below the selection baseline
adapted same-route FP32 Recall@100 is no more than 0.0025 below the original same-route FP32 teacher
lexicographic_order: maximum mean query cosine to the original query

pilot_gate.interpretation: Passing is a development signal from one selected seed. It is not independent confirmation and does not authorize future-holdout access or RARS combination.

prohibited_actions: editing this protocol or implementation after observing the first v7 training or selection metric
opening oracle_audit, future_method_holdout, outer-validation, clean-test, or external-collection outcomes
updating the encoder, document embeddings, IVF centroids, inverted lists, PQ codebooks, or PQ codes
routing with the adapted query in this pilot
calling an unjudged challenger explicitly non-relevant
selecting a checkpoint by training loss or by an unguarded Recall@100 maximum
training or evaluating RARS in this stage
claiming deployment speed, official MS MARCO performance, external confirmation, novelty of generic ranking-aware QAT, paper readiness, or SIGIR readiness
